role.summary: Inspects incoming moulded parts per lot, releases or rejects them

processes.name: Inspect an incoming lot
processes.summary: Sample, check cosmetics and dimensions, then release or reject

people.involvement: Receives NCRs, decides on supplier action

steps.title: Pull the sample
steps.detail: Take the sample size from the sampling table for the lot size

steps.title: Compare with the limit samples
steps.detail: Limit samples are in the QC cabinet, drawer 3

steps.title: Check cosmetic defects
steps.detail: Inspect under the light box, visible faces first

steps.title: Measure the boss diameter
steps.detail: Caliper on the boss, compare with the drawing tolerance
steps.branch_question: Did the sample pass both checks?

steps.title: Quarantine the lot
steps.detail: Red tag and move to the hold area

steps.title: Raise an NCR to the SQE
Record results
steps.detail: Enter pass/fail in the inspection log

rules.text: Sink mark visible at arm's length on a visible face → reject
Anything you can catch with a fingernail → reject, any face

scenarios.situation: A faint sink mark on the inside face; you can't feel it with a fingernail.
scenarios.question: Accept or reject?
scenarios.explanation: Hidden face and not catchable (R-001, R-002)
